newsitem.title: USA: 1960s trailer is "His and Hers" present of 1996.
newsitem.headline: 1960s trailer is "His and Hers" present of 1996.

text.p: Trailer homes, long a symbol of the humble lifestyle, got a new look on Monday when Neiman Marcus launched its glossy Christmas catalogue and showcased a 1960s-style Airstream trailer as its "His and Hers" present for Christmas 1996.
The Airstream's classic silver, bullet-shaped exterior hides a luxurious interior and a price tag of $195,000.
Neiman Marcus called it the "ultimate in retro-chic."

Hand-painted murals, antique rugs and brightly coloured fabrics created by husband-and-wife design team Richard and Victoria MacKenzie-Childs transform the Airstream into a work of art -- and well out of the reach of ordinary Americans.
The Neiman Marcus annual Christmas Book, aside from heralding the start of the Christmas shopping period, offers a wide assortment of exclusive -- and expensive -- gifts.

This year's Dallas-based collection includes a $100,000 fountain pen, a Jaguar XK8 Convertible for about $75,000 and an up-market dog kennel dubbed a "neoclassical pet mansion," boasting an interior green velvet cushion and selling for $9,400.
When the high-fashion retailer launched its catalogue at the Dallas Museum of Art, most attention focused on the 35-foot Airstream trailer.
Company officials said it sleeps four and is perfect for travelling holidays but that several potential buyers thought it would be ideal as a backyard cabana, perhaps next to the swimming pool.
Past "His and Hers" presents have included airplanes, a pair of Louis XIV bathtubs and a day at the circus.
Also in this year's catalogue is a replica of the "X-Wing Starfighter" from the Star Wars movie released 20 years ago.
Only one replica is available and will be sold through an auction by mail. The minimum bid was set at $35,000.
